items.subject: I published a Rubik's Cube paper. Can I earn $25 from you?
items.summary: Hillary Yang, a Stanford freshman and cuber, offers three cubing video ideas for $25 as a 48 hour challenge.
items.action: Decide whether to hire Hillary for $25
items.body:
Hey Caiden!

I'm a freshman at Stanford, and I actually coauthored a research paper on why scrambling a Rubik's Cube requires at least 26 random moves. (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20630) I'm also a cuber (2019YANH09).

I came across your content and figured a fellow cubing nerd might appreciate a slightly ridiculous entrepreneurial challenge.

I'm trying to earn $250 in 48 hours by convincing 10 people to hire me for $25 each.

No donations. Actual work only.

Would you hire me for $25?

I'll create three mathematically interesting cubing video ideas, complete with titles and hooks. Or give me another tiny cubing-related challenge!

I'll deliver within 24 hours.

Want to be one of my 10 customers?

Hillary Yang
